Freeze now_s and use same-day expiry; assert n_eligible==0 with explicit invalid/future-clock reason. Positive control with measured current quote remains eligible. Calculate raw event-time skew before clamping or reject future times outside an explicit documented clock tolerance; do not invent now for missing time.
